note: Rewritten only by `make bench-bless`. Every value is a measurement, in reference-machine units (runner factor 1.0); a time budget gets the factor as headroom at gate time and an RSS budget never does (ADR-004 §11.8). One row was re-measured in place rather than re-blessed wholesale: `warm.reindex.noop.ms.small` is 2.0 ms of store-side `elapsed_ms` since `reco-7tc` skipped the walk, where it was 48.3 ms of whole-process time, and the two are different quantities that must not gate each other. A whole `make bench-bless` from the same box would have carried seven unrelated rows that measure red against this bless into the baseline as though they were intended; that is the gate's business, not `reco-7tc`'s.
